raw_response:
I am a young man farming rented land here in Benshagul Gumuz, and maize is my main hope this season. The land is not mine, so I must be careful with money, but I know maize gives better yield if I put some DAP at planting and urea when it grows. I cannot afford much fertilizer or improved seed every year, but since I have some schooling I try to follow what the extension worker tells us. I will rely mostly on my own hands and my family, and call a few neighbors only for weeding and harvest.
